# B1b — deterministic contribution-card rule engine (`rules.py`)

All volunteer, task, card and evidence-ref examples and fixtures in this lane are **SYNTHETIC**. No real person or real event is represented.

## Files written by this subagent

- `backend/app/evidence/rules.py` — implemented `check_card(card: ContributionCard, all_cards: list[ContributionCard], attendance_rows: list[dict]) -> list[Flag]` plus private helpers. Purely deterministic: no LLM, network, randomness, clock read, or mutation of cards / rows / status. Nothing is auto-rejected.
- `backend/tests/evidence/test_rules.py` — 33 tests, one or more positive tests per rule code, negative/clean tests, immutability and edge-case tests.
- `backend/tests/evidence/__init__.py` — marker docstring.
- `docs/lanes/B-llm-evidence/reports/B1b_rules.md` — this report.

## Rule list (`code` | `severity` | deterministic definition)

| code | severity | definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hours_exceed_recorded` | warn | A matching attendance row gives numeric `recorded_hours` and `claimed_hours > recorded_hours + 0.01`. Epsilon tolerates rounding; if several rows match, the largest recorded value is used. |
| `no_attendance_record` | warn | No row is attributable to `(volunteer_id, task_id)` after tolerant alias/case/whitespace matching. |
| `implausible_hours` | block | `claimed_hours > 12` in a day (strict). |
| `duplicate_evidence_ref` | warn | A non-blank evidence ref on this card also appears on another card in the batch (compared after `strip()` + `casefold()`). |
| `identical_summary_text` | warn | Non-empty summary identical to another card's after `strip()` + `casefold()` + whitespace collapse. |
| `overlapping_tasks` | warn | Same volunteer, strictly overlapping parseable `check_in`/`check_out` windows on two different task ids, one being this card's task. `HH:MM` and ISO datetimes supported; inverted, zero-length, mixed dated/time-only and unparseable windows are skipped rather than false-flagged. |
| `minor_without_guardian_consent` | block | Any matching row or card context gives `age < 18` (or `is_minor` true) and no source has `guardian_consent is True`. |
| `self_declared_skill_unconfirmed` | info | A matching row or card context has non-empty `self_declared_skills`, or a flag labelled `self_declared_skill`. |
| `round_number_inflation` | info | `claimed_hours` is an exact whole number **and** at least 3 cards in the batch (including this one) claim exactly that value. |
| `missing_evidence_ref` | warn | This card has no non-blank `evidence_refs`. |

## 10th rule justification (`missing_evidence_ref`)

A contribution card with no pointer to an artifact (photo, signed sheet, host note) cannot be independently checked, so the host should be nudged to attach one. It is a **warning**, not a block: small, low-risk activities may legitimately produce no saved artifact, and a host can still confirm the card manually. It is also independent of the other nine rules (e.g. a card with no refs cannot trigger `duplicate_evidence_ref`), so it adds coverage rather than duplicating an existing signal.

## Test count and coverage

- 33 tests were collected and all 33 passed in the targeted run (pytest printed `33 passed`).
- At least one positive test per rule code; a dedicated test asserts the union of emitted codes equals all 10 expected codes.
- Negative/clean-card test (no flags), info-only test, epsilon-boundary test, immutability test (deep-copied card, other cards, rows and `status` compared before/after), unparseable/inverted-time no-false-flag test, odd-key tolerance test, deterministic-repeat test, and a flag-field test (`code`, `severity`, plain-English `message`).

## Failures in the full run (honest report)

The full suite command printed `2496 failed, 174 passed, 60 warnings in 47.23s` and exited 1. Every failing test id printed by pytest belongs to `tests/solver/test_factories.py` (e.g. `test_full_case_is_deterministic`, `test_parametrized_seed_fixture_shape[...]`, `test_scarce_skill_knob_produces_unfillable_role`, `test_minor_consent_knobs_reachable`). No failure id belongs to `tests/evidence/test_rules.py`; the only mention of that file in the full output is its 59-warning summary line. `git status --short` at the time showed `?? backend/tests/solver/test_factories.py` and `?? backend/tests/solver/conftest.py` and modifications to solver files, i.e. another subagent's files were untracked / mid-write during this full run. The lead should re-run the full suite authoritatively after those files settle.

## Limitations

- Attendance rows missing a volunteer id are not attributed to a card; rows with a volunteer id but no task id are treated as matching (documented tolerance), so a wrong-task row without a task id cannot be detected.
- Overlap checks compare only same-date ISO windows or two time-only windows; a dated window versus a time-only window is skipped to avoid false positives. Overnight shifts (end before start) are skipped.
- `round_number_inflation` is a batch-level heuristic with a fixed threshold of 3 identical integer-hour claims; it cannot distinguish genuine identical shifts from copied ones and is deliberately `info`.
- `minor_without_guardian_consent` requires `guardian_consent is True` (strict boolean); string `"true"` is not accepted as consent.
- No NER and no free-text inference: self-declaration is detected only via explicit keys/flags.
- `ContributionCard` has no age/consent fields in the shared schema; card-context values are read from model extras when present.
